llmsSummary: MyMemos is a free, local-first browser extension that replaces your New Tab page with a private notes workspace. Notes stay on your device in IndexedDB and attachments in OPFS-no account, no cloud sync, no server for your content. Includes a Notion-style block editor with slash commands, markdown paste, images and voice notes, fuzzy search (⌘K), seven built-in themes plus custom themes, and a live browser demo.

faq.question: What is MyMemos?
faq.answer: MyMemos is a free browser extension that replaces your browser's New Tab with a local-first notes workspace. Every time you open a new tab, your notes are ready-no separate app to launch.

faq.question: Is MyMemos free?
faq.answer: Yes. MyMemos is free and open source (MIT license). There is no subscription, account, or paid tier.

faq.question: Does MyMemos require an account or cloud sync?
faq.answer: No. MyMemos does not require an account or cloud sync. Your notes and attachments are stored locally in the browser. Nothing is sent to a MyMemos server.

faq.question: Where is my data stored in MyMemos?
faq.answer: All notes and attachments stay on your device. Page content lives in IndexedDB; images and voice notes use the browser's Origin Private File System (OPFS); preferences use the extension settings store (or localStorage in the web demo).

faq.question: How is MyMemos different from Notion or Evernote?
faq.answer: MyMemos lives on your New Tab, not a separate website or app. It is local-first and private by default: no login, no sync servers, and no cloud dependency for your notes. Best for quick capture when you hit ⌘T.

faq.question: Can I try MyMemos before installing the browser extension?
faq.answer: Yes. A live browser demo is available here. Same UI as the extension: pages in IndexedDB, settings in localStorage (instead of the extension settings store). Demo data does not sync with the installed extension.
